title: Bigin 'Emails Sent' metric reads far too low because it skips organization address sends
symptoms: Emails Sent shows single digits while workflow emails are visibly going out
Workflow emails appear on records but not in the Emails Sent drill-down
cause: The metric counts only mail sent from a user's connected mailbox. Workflow emails sent from organization email addresses have no user attached and are left out. Opens count repeat opens, so opens far above sends is normal and not a bug.
fix: Keep Emails Sent off dashboards and confirm workflow sends on the records themselves.
apply: Open a deal > Timeline and check the workflow emails listed there.
